configurePresets.name: cuda-dev
configurePresets.displayName: Dev with the CUDA dense backend
configurePresets.description: CMAKE_CUDA_COMPILER and CUDAToolkit_ROOT are both pinned because they must be. This machine has two CUDA toolkits: a bare enable_language(CUDA) resolves /usr/bin/nvcc (12.4, which rejects GCC 15), and FindCUDAToolkit independently resolves libcudart from /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu (also 12.4) while the headers come from /usr/local/cuda (13.4). That header/runtime mismatch compiles and links silently but misreads cudaDeviceProp fields. See docs/adr/0014.

configurePresets.name: cuda12-dev
configurePresets.displayName: Dev with the CUDA dense backend on CUDA 12.x
configurePresets.description: CUDA 12.x build. /usr/bin/nvcc is the Ubuntu nvidia-cuda-toolkit (12.4), whose headers and libcudart live under /usr, so CUDAToolkit_ROOT is /usr. CUDA 12.4 accepts host GCC up to 13, so GCC 13 compiles the WHOLE build (C++ and the nvcc host pass) rather than only the .cu objects, which avoids a mixed-compiler boundary. GCC 12+ is the project minimum (docs/adr/0001). Exists because a driver older than the CUDA 13 runtime (e.g. 566.x, which runs up to CUDA 12.7) cannot run a CUDA 13 build at all. See docs/adr/0014 section 17.
